justification: Typed zone lists decided a warning and whether Housing SEPP rules load. Standard: two components, one new reader of an existing endpoint.

pre_impl.existing_data: lep_land_use_table via GET /api/lep/permissibility, gated by lep_zone_coverage (489 complete rows, 28 councils)
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Uncovered council or zone gives null: ADG card says not checked, Housing SEPP is kept
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Render-time only, every page view from deploy

functions.name: zoneProhibitsAllDwellings
functions.input: LEP land use rows for the zone, or null
functions.output: true only when every dwelling row is prohibited
functions.if_none: returns false so housing rules stay

values.guard_at: three-state: undefined loading, null not checked

break_it.scenario: MU1 zone where the council table is not loaded
break_it.what_happens: Before: Housing SEPP dropped by the typed list. Now: kept

break_it.scenario: R2 zone where the LEP permits residential flat buildings
break_it.what_happens: Before: amber may-prohibit warning. Now: no warning

break_it.scenario: The permissibility endpoint fails or times out
break_it.what_happens: ADG card shows the not-checked note; Housing SEPP kept
break_it.how: fetchLepTable returns null on any failure

falsifiable_check.observed_red: Ran the new component tests against the unfixed components: 4 failed, 1 passed.
